name: Gemini 345Lg
summary: Gemini 345Lg is a rugged stereo camera for outdoor robots, autonomous forklifts and industrial mobile platforms. It combines GMSL2/FAKRA-C connectivity with wide-field depth, color and infrared sensing. An IP67 enclosure, broad temperature range and vibration resistance support navigation and obstacle detection outdoors.

description.en: Gemini 345Lg is a rugged stereo camera for outdoor robots, autonomous forklifts and industrial mobile platforms. It combines GMSL2/FAKRA-C connectivity with wide-field depth, color and infrared sensing. An IP67 enclosure, broad temperature range and vibration resistance support navigation and obstacle detection outdoors.

sources.title: Gemini 345Lg: Outdoor Stereo Vision Camera | Orbbec
sources.quote: Ideal range: 0.3-6m. Working range: 0.3-10m. Depth accuracy: ±3% at 3m and ±6% at 6m (90%x90% ROI). Spatial precision: ≤1.2% at 3m. The 88mm baseline enables accurate long-range depth sensing for obstacle detection.

sources.title: Gemini 345Lg: Outdoor Stereo Vision Camera | Orbbec
sources.quote: Depth FOV: Wide mode 104° x 87° or Standard mode 91° x 78°. Color FOV: 137° x 71°. Infrared FOV: 130° x 95°. This ultra-wide FOV provides comprehensive coverage for outdoor robot navigation and obstacle detection.

sources.title: Gemini 345Lg: Outdoor Stereo Vision Camera | Orbbec
sources.quote: The Gemini 345Lg has IP67 ingress protection rating (fully dustproof and waterproof up to 1m submersion). It also features exceptional vibration resistance verified by testing at 10-2000 Hz, 6.4 grms, making it suitable for rugged outdoor robotics applications.

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: GMSL2 FAKRA-C; USB Type-C for development

sources.title: Gemini 345Lg: Outdoor Stereo Vision Camera | Orbbec
sources.quote: The Gemini 345Lg features a GMSL2 serializer with FAKRA-C connector for robust, high-bandwidth data transmission in outdoor robotics. It also supports USB Type-C for development and debugging. Power requirements: ≥600mA @ 12V for GMSL2 or ≥1.5A @ 5V for USB 3.0.

sources.quote: The Gemini 345Lg operates reliably in ambient temperatures from -20°C to 65°C (<95% RH non-condensing). Storage temperature range is -40°C to 85°C. This extreme temperature capability makes it ideal for outdoor robotics in hot or cold environments.

sources.title: CES 2026: Gemini 305 & 345Lg with Jetson Thor
sources.quote: Las Vegas, January 6, 2026 — Orbbec unveiled two breakthrough products at CES 2026, advancing the future of robotic vision: the Gemini 305, an ultra-compact stereo 3D camera engineered specifically for robotic wrist mounting, and the Gemini 345Lg, a rugged stereo vision camera built to thrive in demanding environments. The company simultaneously announced full platform compatibility between its flagship Gemini series cameras and NVIDIA Jetson Thor , while unveiling its dual manufacturing capabilities spanning Shunde, China and Vietnam—marking a comprehensive upgrade in both R&D and manufacturing prowess within the robotics vision sector.
